responses.change: Updated the dirty status check to run git status --porcelain --ignored and scan for modifications in configured includeIgnored files on disk, ensuring safety checkpoints are generated before restore if any ignored scratch files are dirty.

Specified concrete, index-isolated restore algorithm using temporary git index and git checkout-index, with comparison/deletion of checkpoint-absent files. Removed alternative read-tree framing from design, contracts, and tasks.

Specified concrete cross-system rollback procedure: wrap SQLite event write and git update-ref in a SQLite transaction, rolling back on update-ref failure. On SQLite commit failure, run compensating git update-ref -d to delete the orphaned ref.
